name: Everything in Evanston B 2023
information:
All sighted speedsolving events will be held at this competition! Because this is not a typical competition, all competitors must read the [Competition Format](#26691-competition-format) tab. Competitors interested in blindfolded events should register for the other competition in this series: [Everything in Evanston A](EverythinginEvanstonA2023).

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org).
